name: Harvest Scream
detailed_description:
Escape the Grind, Embrace the Fear.

Tired of the corporate rat race? The endless meetings, soul-crushing tasks, and the constant stress? We get it. Your character feels the same. All they want is to live freely, make their own choices, and truly steer their own life. That's why they've decided to quit their soul-sucking job.

But your boss has other plans for you. "You want freedom? You'll have to earn it first!" they declare, before throwing you into an mind-bending simulation. This isn't just a game; it's your ultimate test! If you can survive this twisted simulated environment, face your fears, and truly break free, the life you've always dreamed of awaits. Fail, however, and you'll be dragged back to your desk, forever trapped in the mundane cycle of your tedious job.

What price will you pay for freedom? Are you ready to confront the dangers lurking in the depths of this simulation and discover who you truly are?

Key Features

  • Become a Master Farmer: Dive deep into the world of agriculture! Cultivate various fruits and vegetables, and even try your hand at beekeeping to produce sweet honey. Grow your farm into a thriving enterprise.

  • Gone Fishing: Grab your rod and reel! Spend peaceful hours by the water, casting your line to catch a variety of fish. It's a perfect way to relax... or to escape for a bit.

  • Manage Your Wealth Wisely: Earning money is crucial, but it's not just about accumulating riches. You'll need to carefully manage your funds to ensure you have enough resources to survive and, more importantly, to diligently fix every anomaly that appears. Your fate depends on it.

  • Dynamic Weather System: Experience the ever-changing beauty and challenge of nature with a completely random weather system. From sunny days to sudden storms, each weather event will add an unpredictable layer to your daily farming and nightly anomaly hunting.

  • A Story That Will Move You: Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative that is both hilariously funny and deeply melancholic. Unravel the mysteries of your situation through a story that promises to evoke a wide range of emotions.

short_description: Farm by day, fix by night. This first-person farming horror game blends agricultural life with terrifying nocturnal anomaly repairs. Survive the monstrous threats that emerge after dusk.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 930MX or AMD Radeon RX 540
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
